## 2. Thrust-to-weight (T/W)

No measured static thrust for an 8520 with a **55 mm** prop at ~3.7 V was found. The only figure is a secondhand ~33-36 gf per motor with **60 mm** props (S19). Three scenarios bracket it; 28 gf is an ASSUMED lower value for the smaller 55 mm prop.

Formula: T/W = (4 x T_motor) / W_takeoff. Hover throttle fraction (thrust) ~ W / (4 x T_motor).

| T per motor (gf) | Tag | T/W at nominal 71.6 g | T/W at worst 93.7 g | T/W at 80 g |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 28 | ASSUMPTION | 1.56 | 1.20 | 1.40 |
| 33 | SOURCED S19 (60 mm) | 1.84 | 1.41 | 1.65 |
| 36 | SOURCED S19 (60 mm) | 2.01 | 1.54 | 1.80 |

Reading: T/W is 1.6-2.0 at nominal weight and drops to 1.2 at worst-case weight. Below ~2 leaves thin margin for altitude-hold and gust rejection (ASSUMPTION: common rule of thumb, not a requirement in the brief). This is the main G1 risk - see open question OQ-3.

| OV2640 (140 mW compressed) via 2.8 V/1.2 V LDOs | 116.7 | 116.7 | SOURCED + ESTIMATE | S9; worst case assumes all power on the 1.2 V LDO: I = 140 mW / 1.2 V |
| Buzzer MLT-5020 (intermittent) | 100.0 | 0.0 | SOURCED | S11; excluded from average |
| **Total 3.3 V** | **838** | **487** | CALC | sum |

TPS63802 rating: 2 A for V_IN >= 2.3 V at V_OUT 3.3 V (S12) -> margin over peak = 2000 / 838 = 2.4x. The ESP32-S3 datasheet also requires a supply able to deliver >= 500 mA to the module.

Battery-side power for 3.3 V average: P = 3.3 V x 487 mA / eta(0.90) = **1.79 W** -> I = P / 3.7 V = **483 mA**.

### 3c. Motors, hover and flight time

Hover power uses a measured thrust efficiency for a generic 8520 + Hubsan H107 prop: 4-5 g/W at 3.5-4.2 V (S20). Not our prop - ESTIMATE.

Formulas: P_hover = W / eta_gW;  I_motors = P_hover / V_nom;  I_total = I_motors + I_3V3,batt + I_5V,batt;  t_flight = (C x HV_derate x usable) / I_total.

| W (g) | eta (g/W) | P_hover (W) | I_motors (A) | I_total (A) | Flight time (min) |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 71.6 | 5 | 14.3 | 3.87 | 4.59 | 6.2 |
| 71.6 | 4 | 17.9 | 4.84 | 5.56 | 5.1 |
| 93.7 | 5 | 18.7 | 5.06 | 5.78 | 4.9 |
| 93.7 | 4 | 23.4 | 6.33 | 7.05 | 4.0 |
| 80.0 | 5 | 16.0 | 4.32 | 5.05 | 5.7 |
| 80.0 | 4 | 20.0 | 5.41 | 6.13 | 4.7 |

Electronics at battery: 0.72 A (3.3 V + 5 V averages above). Capacity 660 mAh (S14) x 0.90 HV derate (ESTIMATE, D-013) x usable 80% (ASSUMPTION). Cross-check: S26 reports 5-6 min for a 59-65 g 8520 build without camera/sensors, consistent in magnitude.

### 3d. Peak battery current (sizing connector, fuse, traces, FETs)

Per-motor full-throttle current 1.6-2.27 A (vendor/maker figures, S21). Electronics peak referred to a 3.0 V battery. I_peak = 4 x I_motor + I_3V3,pk x 3.3/(0.90 x 3.0) + I_5V,pk x 5/(0.85 x 3.0) = **8.0-10.7 A**. Motor stall can reach 10.6 A (measured, S21) to 15.1 A (maker table, S21) per motor for short transients (start-up, blocked prop).

Connector check: JST-PH is rated 2 A per contact (S27). Estimated hover current 4.6-5.6 A and peak 8.0-10.7 A exceed that rating. BT2.0 is claimed 9 A continuous by its vendor (no formal datasheet, S27). -> Open question OQ-2 / D-011.

## 4. Component calculations

### 4a. BQ24074 charge current (S22)

I_CHG = K_ISET / R_ISET, K_ISET = 890 A*Ohm typ (797-975). Target 500 mA (~0.76C for 660 mAh, ASSUMPTION: conservative below 1C). R_ISET = 890/0.5 = 1780 Ohm -> nearest E96 **1.78 kOhm**. Resulting I_CHG range = 448-548 mA (typ 500 mA). R_ISET must be within 590 Ohm-8.9 kOhm (datasheet) - OK. Input current limit: USB500 mode via EN1/EN2 (ASSUMPTION: no Type-C current advertisement is read).

### 4b. INA226 shunt (S8)

Full-scale shunt voltage +/-81.92 mV. Design max measurable current 12 A (ASSUMPTION: above the ~11 A full-throttle estimate). R_shunt <= 81.92 mV / 12 A = 6.83 mOhm -> select **5 mOhm**: range = 81.92/5 = 16.4 A, LSB = 2.5 uV / 5 mOhm = 0.50 mA. Dissipation P = I^2 R: at 5 A = 0.125 W, at 9 A = 0.405 W, at 16 A transient = 1.28 W -> choose a >= 1 W part at G2.

### 4c. Motor MOSFET AO3400A (S23)

- I = 1.00 A: P = I^2 x 48 mOhm = 48 mW (worst-case Rds(on) max at Vgs 2.5 V; actual gate drive 3.3 V gives lower Rds - curve value at 3.3 V UNCONFIRMED).
- I = 1.60 A: P = I^2 x 48 mOhm = 123 mW (worst-case Rds(on) max at Vgs 2.5 V; actual gate drive 3.3 V gives lower Rds - curve value at 3.3 V UNCONFIRMED).
- I = 2.27 A: P = I^2 x 48 mOhm = 247 mW (worst-case Rds(on) max at Vgs 2.5 V; actual gate drive 3.3 V gives lower Rds - curve value at 3.3 V UNCONFIRMED).
- Stall 10.6 A transient: P = 5.4 W - must be short; firmware ramp limits and the 15 A fuse bound it. SOT-23 thermal resistance check at G3.

### 4d. Series drop in the battery path (S24)

- 5 A through Q1 + Q2 (2 x 9.8 mOhm max at -2.5 V) + 5 mOhm shunt: V_drop = 5 x 24.6 mOhm = **123 mV** (+ fuse, connector, traces - UNCONFIRMED); FET loss 245 mW each.
- 9 A through Q1 + Q2 (2 x 9.8 mOhm max at -2.5 V) + 5 mOhm shunt: V_drop = 9 x 24.6 mOhm = **221 mV** (+ fuse, connector, traces - UNCONFIRMED); FET loss 794 mW each.

### 4e. Prop clearance (adjacent props on a square X frame)

Adjacent motor spacing s = D / sqrt(2) (D = diagonal motor-to-motor). Tip gap g = s - d_prop.

| D (mm) | s (mm) | gap, 55 mm props | gap, 65 mm props |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 90 | 63.6 | 8.6 | -1.4 |
| 95 | 67.2 | 12.2 | 2.2 |
| 100 | 70.7 | 15.7 | 5.7 |

Guard rings need radial clearance plus wall thickness per prop; 65 mm props leave <= 5.7 mm between tips even at 100 mm, so guards would overlap. -> 55 mm at 95 mm (D-019).

### 4f. VL53L5CX firmware upload time on a 400 kHz I2C bus (S25)

t ~ bytes x 9 bits (8 data + ACK) / f_SCL = 86016 x 9 / 400 kHz = **1.94 s** per boot (ignores address/command overhead; ESTIMATE). The bus runs at 400 kHz because VL53L1X and QMC5883P are 400 kHz devices.
